name: Matjaž Nemec-After § 6-Am 13
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 6a. Stresses that savings are absolutely necessary and regrets that Parliament’s budget has steadily increased year after year during previous legislative terms; therefore calls on Parliament to set as a main objective for its own budget the limitation of its own costs to the greatest extent possible and the pursuit of significant savings, in order to send a message of exemplarity and responsibility to Union citizens;
